page.overview:
What is Mega Charizard Y?

It is the version mascot for Pocket Monsters Red Version, , and their Generation III remake, .

Charizard is a large, draconic Pokémon that differs greatly from its pre-evolved forms. The red skin coloration of Charmeleon is no longer apparent, as Charizard appears to have reverted to the orange/yellow coloration of Charmander. Two large fangs can be seen when its mouth is closed. When its mouth is open, its lower fangs and a slender but long tongue can be seen. The single horn that was on the back of its head is now two, one on either side. The most notable difference between Charizard and its pre-evolved forms are the large, dragon-like wings that have developed on its back, which gives Charizard the capability of flying.

In Generation II, Charizard's Shiny form was purple with the inside of its wings being green. In Generation III onwards, its orange skin is black while the blue of its wings is maroon.

Charizard's Mega Evolution form using Charizardite X is significantly different yet more ferocious from its standard appearance, as it now has a black body color and blue flames from its mouth and on its tail. While using Charizardite Y, Mega Charizard has a big horn on the top of its head and larger wings, but still resembles its normal look. A Shiny Mega Charizard X has a dark greenish body and its wings become red. Mega Charizard Y as a Shiny has its overall colors the same as its normal Shiny form but the body's shade is slightly lighter.
